title: Units and counits for restriction of an adjunction through completion reflectors
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be additive $A$-linear categories for a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-linear-category]. Let $\mathcal A_c,\mathcal B_c$ be full additive subcategories, and let $C_{\mathcal A},C_{\mathcal B}$ be additive $A$-linear endofunctors with values in those subcategories. Suppose natural maps $\kappa_X:X\to C(X)$ have the following universal property: for every object $Y$ of the indicated subcategory, precomposition by $\kappa_X$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(C(X),Y)\to\operatorname{Hom}(X,Y)$. Assume the subcategories consist exactly of the objects with invertible $\kappa$. Let $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $R:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be additive $A$-linear functors with a specified adjunction $L\dashv R$, unit $\eta$ and counit $\varepsilon$, and assume $R(\mathcal B_c)\subseteq\mathcal A_c$. Define $P=C_{\mathcal B}L|_{\mathcal A_c}$ and $D=R|_{\mathcal B_c}$.
There is an $A$-linear natural adjunction bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B_c}(PM,N)\xrightarrow{\ -\circ\kappa_{LM}\ }\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(LM,N)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{adj}}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A_c}(M,DN).$$
The resulting unit $\eta^c$ and counit $\varepsilon^c$ satisfy, as ambient morphisms,
$$\eta^c_M=R(\kappa_{LM})\eta_M,\qquad \varepsilon^c_N\kappa_{LRN}=\varepsilon_N.$$
They are natural and satisfy both triangle identities. More generally the ordinary adjunct of $t\kappa_{LM}$ equals the completed adjunct of every $t:PM\to N$. The functors $P,D$ are additive and $A$-linear. These statements fix the adjunction by its Hom bijection, rather than merely asserting existence of some adjunction.

mathlib_searches.query: Restrict an adjunction to full reflective subcategories when the right adjoint preserves local objects with explicit completed unit and counit formulas
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful assumes an isomorphism between the ambient left adjoint and the proposed restricted left adjoint. Here L need not preserve complete objects and the map L M to C L M need not be invertible. Composing with the reflector and restricting gives a construction, but proving its stated noninvertible-unit formulas and A-linear Hom bijection requires the separate reflector calculation.
